name: weavesharp
description: The graph surface's TypeScript tooling: type checking and tests. Nothing here is published.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p src/surface && tsc -p experiments/canvas && tsc -p experiments/vscode/tsconfig.host.json --noEmit && tsc -p experiments/vscode/tsconfig.webview.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node --test "src/surface/test/**/*.test.ts" "experiments/canvas/test/**/*.test.ts" && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p experiments/vscode/tsconfig.host.json && node experiments/vscode/copy-resources.cjs && node --test "experiments/vscode/out/host/experiments/vscode/test/*.test.js"
